research_version: Micro180 V13 independent positive-cycle source-quote entry clock
positive_selection: original completed-minute-cycle net>0, reconstructed mapped Coinexx complete-cycle quote_net>0; all entry/exit mapping lags 0..2000ms; family is ex-post training label only
indicators_and_causal_features: Previous completed observed one-second S1 efficiency/velocity/range, real forming 5s/15s baskets, returns/acceleration 1,3,5,10,15,30,60,180,300 seconds, source prior-completed M5 ATR, Bid/Ask spread, minute anchor/price barrier and minute phase
runtime: First candidate hazard generates BUY/SELL using actual Coinexx quote, executes at next observed second first quote; second conditional on OWN prior first trade close and opposite direction, maximum one position. No teacher timestamps, family labels, P&L or R9 REAL event used at runtime.
other_gate_experiments_not_promoted: Early/mature split, minute-start prior gate and B/C early expert were examined locally; none was promoted over the frozen baseline without robust improvements to positive-cycle recall and entry-price concordance.
engineering_safety: Original R9, V9, V11 and native MQL5 untouched; new isolated research branch only, no orders; outputs are compact JSON and two ~0.29MB LightGBM text models, no duplicate tick warehouses.
next_entry_development_gate: Optimize early B/C and second-leg on-policy event-clock precision using as-of first-leg exit and multihorizon information, frozen chronological validation before wider 10-part replay.
